pre_evaluation_protocol: locked in runner before evaluation; no test-seed tuning

protocol.reward_model: independent Bernoulli(c[i,k,t]); potential uniforms common by seed/time/edge
protocol.capacity: one edge per agent and task; exact assignment solver
protocol.policy_information: public task/agent identities, clock and own selected-edge feedback only; no true means or breakpoints
protocol.original_rng_stream: same seed xor 0x5B3B and edge draw order as original, extended from 300 to 2400

sw_ucb.rule: W=round(2 sqrt(T log(T)/M)), clipped to [1,T]; M is predeclared number of changes; stationary W=T

glr_cucb.segment_count_assumption: unknown; same theorem-derived setting in all conditions
glr_cucb.threshold: paper beta(n,delta), implementation's cited conservative Q upper bound
glr_cucb.restart: global after any pair detector signals
